title: observability-weekly-2026-08-03
body:
Weekly Observability Notes — 2026-08-03
Owner: Priya Patel
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Zoe, Marcus, Lina (SRE), Rahul (Serving Runtime)

High-level summary:
- Tracing: rolled out adaptive sampling pilot to 20% of production traffic for chat routes. Initial results show 15% CPU reduction on collectors with ~2-3% drop in trace coverage for low-risk routes. Need to validate signal retention for latency P95/P99 analysis.
- Dashboards: new cost-telemetry Grafana dashboard merged (PR #278). Shows per-route GPU-hour and estimated per-token cost. First pass looks reasonable but some routes show unexpectedly high per-token cost - investigating model routing and batching interactions.
- Cost telemetry: working with billing to align billing_hours -> telemetry_hours mapping. Discrepancy in July where telemetry undercounted GPU-hours by ~4%. Likely due to short lived preemptible instances not reported; tracking with infra.

Detailed notes:
1) Tracing
- Adaptive sampling rollout (JIRA-OBS-1123):
  - Pilot config: sample 100% for error traces and latency > 500ms; adaptive sampling for low-latency chat/text routes down to 5% during steady-state traffic.
  - Observed: collector CPU down ~15% on 3 nodes, redis patch reduced KV-cache thrash.
  - Risk: some downstream traces used for model-quality regressions (evals) are sampled less; added temporary bypass for requests with eval flag.
  - Action items:
    - Ethan: add a sampling override hook for flagged eval requests (ETA 2026-08-06).
    - Zoe: run trace-retention QA comparing P99 latency attribution pre/post sampling change (ETA 2026-08-07).

- Trace schema update: added span tag `model.variant` and `routing.path`. Note: high-cardinality risk for `routing.path` - plan to normalize values.
  - Marcus to propose normalization rules (list of canonical route buckets) by 2026-08-05.

2) Dashboards
- Cost-telemetry dashboard merged into staging (PR #278). Key panels:
  - per-route GPU-hours (last 7d), per-route estimated $/k tokens, batching efficiency heatmap, model-variant cost breakdown.
  - Panel notes: batching efficiency correlates strongly with cost; small routes with low QPS have poor batching -> higher per-token cost.
- Next steps:
  - Add drilldown from route -> pod-level GPU utilisation (requires new exporter metric).
  - Lina to open infra ticket to expose `pod_gpu_util` exporter by 2026-08-06.

3) Cost telemetry & billing alignment
- July discrepancy investigation:
  - Hypothesis: preemptible instances and short-lived scale bursts not fully instrumented in telemetry pipeline.
  - Rahul to add ephemeral instance probe and emit `instance_lifetime_seconds` metric (ETA 2026-08-09).
  - Finance wants a reconciliation report for July by 2026-08-10. Priya to draft initial reconciliation and assumptions.

4) Alerts & Noise reduction
- We still get noisy alerts from high-cardinality metrics (span tag explosion after canary deploy).
  - Short-term: disable alert on `span.tag.*` cardinality until normalization in place.
  - Long-term: implement cardinality cap and warn-only policy for newly-added span tags.
  - Action: Marcus + Observability platform to define warning policy (ETA 2026-08-12).

5) Incidents / Postmortems
- 2026-07-30 partial tracing backlog: collector OOM due to uncontrolled housekeeping task. Root cause: housekeeping backlog retries with quadratic growth. Fixed with immediate kill/restart and concurrency cap. Postmortem doc drafted (link in linked_artifacts).

6) Standup highlights (day-by-day snapshots)
- Mon 2026-08-03: Standup - prioritized adaptive-sampling follow-ups, confirmed PR merge for cost dashboard.
- Tue 2026-08-04: Standup - Ethan blocked on test harness flakiness for sampling overrides.
- Wed 2026-08-05: Standup - Marcus to present normalization plan, Lina to open exporter ticket.
- Thu 2026-08-06: Standup - Rahul to start instance probe work, Zoe beginning P99 retention QA.
- Fri 2026-08-07: Standup - review week, schedule next week's spike on batching experiment for small routes.

7) Open questions / decisions required
- Do we keep adaptive sampling at 20% traffic or expand to 50% for low-risk routes? Decision pending QA on signal retention. (Expected decision by 2026-08-10).
- How to tag model-level cost: add explicit `model.size` tag or infer from model.variant? Prefer explicit tag from serving runtime - ask Runtime team.

8) Action items (owner - ETA)
- Ethan Morales - implement sampling override hook for eval requests - 2026-08-06.
- Zoe Kim - run trace-retention QA and report differences (P95/P99 attribution) - 2026-08-07.
- Marcus Li - normalization rules for routing.path tag - 2026-08-05.
- Lina (SRE) - expose pod_gpu_util exporter metric and open infra ticket - 2026-08-06.
- Rahul (Serving Runtime) - add ephemeral instance probe metric - 2026-08-09.
- Priya Patel - prepare July telemetry vs billing reconciliation draft - 2026-08-10.

Notes / rough ideas:
- Batch-first routing policy experiment: consider small artificial batching window for low-QPS routes to improve per-token cost. Spike next week to measure latency impact.
- Cost forecast: if batching improves efficiency by 20% on small routes, projected platform spend reduction ~3-5% overall. Need to validate.

References / links:
- JIRA: JIRA-OBS-1123 (adaptive sampling)
- GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/278 (cost dashboard)
- Confluence: confluence://obs/tracing-sampling-playbook

End of notes.
summary: Adaptive sampling pilot rolled to 20% of traffic; cost dashboard merged; investigating July telemetry undercount; several action items assigned.
